a02Resolution.question: why rotate the gateway credential at all, given Magpie compatibility is done
a02Resolution.answer: Magpie compatibility is complete - configured key or bearer token, header environment references, real task and resume validated - and rotation is an action the application's own administrative surface performs, not a harness feature. The half that was still listed as an item is therefore closed as not-a-requirement rather than as work in progress.
